arguments.sql:
SELECT p.id, quote(p.publisher_name) AS stored_name,
       COUNT(s.id) AS attributed_heroes,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN s.height_cm > 200 THEN 1 END) AS heroes_over_200
FROM publisher AS p
LEFT JOIN superhero AS s ON s.publisher_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.publisher_name
ORDER BY p.id
